notes:
Dahu 0.104.2 beta for Windows.

- Large 3DM files: importing no longer fails with "Failed to fetch" when one upload connection drops; uploads use larger chunks and retry lost connections.
- Large 3DM files: much less memory for imported polygon meshes (a 546 MB test file: geometry engine 9.3 GB -> 4.0 GB). Very large meshes show their border and crease edges instead of every triangle edge; faces, exports and mesh tools always use the full mesh.
- Since 0.103.0: gumball scale segment highlight, neutral centre handle, Shift for uniform 3D scale; faster edge hover in Shaded modes.

Known limit: very large models still need several GB of memory in the app window (#165).

Unsigned: on first install choose More info > Run anyway.
